balance.power_profile: Combat capability is an explicit integer game-design band from 1 to 5, based on training, demonstrated feats, Force or weapon mastery and the selected depiction. Unranked subjects retain a visibly provisional 2/5 baseline. Story prominence and appearance frequency are not stat inputs; limited evidence is not evidence of weakness.
balance.stat_formula: combat_points = {1:100,2:140,3:200,4:290,5:420}[combat]; rarity_points = round(power_multiplier*100); base attack and health = (role_base*rarity_points*combat_points+5000)//10000. For category limited, final attack and health = (rounded_base_stat*110+50)//100; otherwise final stat = base stat. Speed = role baseline. Both stages round halves up. Shared numeric scale across card types and both arenas; no physical-size, ID, story-importance or supply-cap-size bonus.
balance.edition_policy: Limited editions receive 10% attack and health above their rounded baseline. Comparable editions match the direct variant_of base rarity, combat rating, role and ability. A labelled depiction_override keeps its own phase-specific rarity, combat and role, then receives the same 10% bonus on that baseline. There is no edition speed bonus; speed follows the selected role. Release windows and lifetime supply caps are unchanged. Event status alone grants no bonus.

source_policy.selection: 835 regular card definitions represent 818 distinct subjects, including explicitly user-approved KOTOR/SWTOR game portrayals with truthful Legends provenance and shared Revan identity. Sixteen limited editions are gated separately; zero event-only definitions remain in this snapshot. Unrelated Legends material still requires an explicitly activated event. Locations, organizations, props and cosmetic identity inflation are excluded.
source_policy.rights: Third-party subject artwork is excluded from this public distribution. Supply images you have permission to use and a matching reviewed asset manifest. Public source links do not grant redistribution permission.

old_republic_game_policy.provenance: Retain the historical Legends/publication label and the selected game phase; do not claim universal Lucasfilm mainline-canon certification.
old_republic_game_policy.other_legends: Unrelated Legends content remains event-only and requires explicit activation, UTC windows and lifetime supply rules.
old_republic_game_policy.identity: Three Revan portrayals share subject_id=darth-revan. Different centuries/phases do not mean different people.

source_policy.public_distribution: Card art paths and art_status describe the expected reviewed asset contract. Run setup-art to download recorded sources and reconstruct reviewed images locally using data/art-sources.json. Subject images are not bundled. Startup separately verifies local files, dimensions, hashes and reviewed manifest entries; metadata alone cannot enable gameplay.

spawn_model.description: Choose an eligible rarity using spawn_weight: Common 54%, Uncommon 22%, Rare 17.8%, Epic 4.2%, Legendary 1.6%, Mythic 0.4%. If both ordinary and activated limited cards are eligible in that rarity, allocate 75% to ordinary and 25% to limited; otherwise allocate 100% to the remaining lane. Use card weight within that lane. The tier total stays fixed as definitions are added. Revision 3 follows final individual combat curation; revisions 1 and 2 keep their recorded historical weights.

card_weight_policy.description: Within a rarity tier, card weight = tier base weight x notability multiplier (fan recognition 1-5). Tier odds are unchanged.

collector_policy.description: Distinct collectors per encounter: Common through Epic 2, Legendary/Mythic 1. Limited editions default to at most 2. An explicit event-only collector_limit may override to 1 through 6. Capacity is snapshotted at creation and reduced to remaining edition stock if necessary; one copy per collector.
